biotools.summary: MIMIC-IV is a freely available, retrospective database of critically ill patients. This resource allows researchers to develop and validate predictive models, exemplified by the study presented, which focuses on predicting in-hospital mortality in patients with sepsis-associated kidney injury receiving renal replacement therapy.
